about: Flight glyphs. Each glyph: flat polygons on a 24-unit grid (x right, y down), drawn in order, later over earlier, each with a tone index. No strokes, no curves, no holes. Tones: 0 lit, 1 mid, 2 shade; light from the top left. A ground's three colours are in 'grounds'. 'maps' is the id in scripts/endless/near_glyphs.gd this replaces, or 'new'.

tree.name: Tree
tree.stands_for: A pass by a spruce: TREE GRAZE, TREES xn.

rock.name: Stone
rock.stands_for: A pass by rock: STONE GRAZE, STONE xn.

ground.name: Land
ground.stands_for: A pass low over the meadow: LAND xn, a pull-out's ground.

water.name: Water
water.stands_for: A pass low over the sea or a lake: WAVES xn, a skip's water.

arch.name: Arch
arch.stands_for: A thread under a rock arch: ARCH.

gap.name: Gap
gap.stands_for: A thread between two rock sides: THREAD.

pull.name: Pull-out
pull.stands_for: The ground closing fast, pulled out of: PULL-OUT.
pull.note: Today a pull-out shows the ground's or the water's glyph.

skip.name: Skip
skip.stands_for: A pull-out off the water: SKIP.
skip.note: Today a skip shows the water glyph.

dive.name: Late pull
dive.stands_for: A long dive hooked out level just over the ground: LATE PULL.

knife.name: Knife edge
knife.stands_for: A thread or a graze flown on a wingtip: KNIFE EDGE.

inverted.name: Inverted
inverted.stands_for: A pass flown upside down: INVERTED.

carve.name: Carve
carve.stands_for: A hard banked turn low over land or water: CARVE.

canopy.name: Canopy run
canopy.stands_for: Fast and low over the crowns: CANOPY RUN.

canyon.name: Canyon run
canyon.stands_for: Walls close on both sides at once: CANYON RUN.

climb.name: Climb
climb.stands_for: Up a steep face, hugging it: CLIMB.

surf.name: Surf
surf.stands_for: Down a steep face, hugging it: SURF.

crest.name: Crest run
crest.stands_for: Low along the top of a tall swell: CREST RUN.
crest.note: Today the crest run borrows the surf glyph.

slalom.name: Slalom
slalom.stands_for: Three trees or more passed abeam on alternating sides: SLALOM.
slalom.note: Reported as a moment; the line score skips it (line_tune.json).

orbit.name: Stack orbit
orbit.stands_for: A turn held round a sea stack: STACK ORBIT.

smash.name: Smash
smash.stands_for: A surge roll bursting a spur or a plug in a bore: SMASH.
smash.note: Today a smash shows the stone glyph.

coin.name: Money
coin.stands_for: Money: what a banked line pays, the shop's prices, the landing card's earned.

surge.name: Surge
surge.stands_for: The surge meter: the charge a line builds toward a surge roll.

roll.name: Roll ready
roll.stands_for: The meter is full: the roll button is the surge roll.

scrape.name: Line lost
scrape.stands_for: A scrape: the unbanked line is lost.

crash.name: Crashed
crash.note: Today a crash is the word alone.

relic.name: Relic ring
relic.stands_for: A find: the ring of hewn blocks to fly through. Also the finds counter.

landing.name: Landing
landing.stands_for: A find: a cairn to set the wheels down by.
landing.note: Today a landing find has no mark of its own.

line.name: Place line
line.stands_for: A find: a course of gates flown against the clock.
line.note: The gates are four corner brackets in the world. Today a line find has no mark of its own.

event.name: Event
event.stands_for: A find: a moment that happens once (the burrower caught, the wall).
event.note: The glint every find carries in the world. Today an event find has no mark of its own.

plane.name: The plane
plane.stands_for: The plane: the pilot's own mark, a figure in the shop, the flight on the landing card.
plane.note: Today the plane has no mark.

falls.name: Waterfall
falls.stands_for: A lake-fed fall with a tunnel behind it.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.stands_for: A bore through the rock: a mouth to fly into.

peak.name: The Peak
peak.stands_for: The Peak: three towers round the tarn, cloud wound round them.

stack.name: Sea stacks
stack.stands_for: The sea stacks off the coast.

balloon.name: Balloon
balloon.stands_for: A hot air balloon: a pass by its cloth or its basket is a graze.

whale.name: Whale
whale.stands_for: The whale of the open sea: its tail stands as the plane comes up.

burrower.name: Burrower
burrower.stands_for: The burrower: unseen under the turf, the ridge it heaves.

race.name: Rival race
race.stands_for: A race against the other planes.

shop.name: Shop
shop.stands_for: A shop's strip: the mast with its lamp and windsock, the open hangar.

door.name: Door
door.stands_for: A door to another land: the ruin hall between its two belfries.

tree_cluster.name: Tree, as a stand
tree_cluster.stands_for: The tree as a stand of three.

coin_block.name: Money, as a gilt block
coin_block.stands_for: Money as one of the ring's gilt blocks.

surge_burst.name: Surge, as a burst
surge_burst.stands_for: The surge as today's sunburst, redrawn in the set's facets.
